# k-mods

> A Korean-curated catalog of Claude Code mods: 66 reviewed mods plus install bundles. Every external mod is pinned to the commit that was reviewed and labeled with what it can do on your machine.

Claude Code mods are an official Claude Code feature (version 2.1.287 or later). A mod is JavaScript or TypeScript code inside a plugin that receives events such as tool calls and prompt submissions, then changes how Claude Code behaves or what it draws.

- Korean site: https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/
- English site: https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/
- GitHub: https://github.com/dogebi/k-mods
- Machine-readable catalog: https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/catalog.json
- Built from k-mods commit 10e9d6a (2026-10-30)

## Install

Inside Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add dogebi/k-mods
/plugin install <name>@k-mods
```

Start with `starter@k-mods` for the recommended set. Run `/reload-plugins` to apply to an open session.

## Guides

- [What are mods?](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/guide/what-are-mods/): Mods are an official Claude Code feature, available from Claude Code 2.1.287.
- [Install guide](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/guide/install/): k-mods is a regular Claude Code plugin marketplace. So installing, updating, and uninstalling all work through Claude Code's /plugin command and the claude plug…
- [Using mods safely](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/guide/safety/): Mods run inside Claude Code with your permissions and without a sandbox. So it matters to know what a mod can do before you install it.
- [mods cheatsheet](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/guide/cheatsheet/): File layout, events, APIs, render sites, and limits for mod development, condensed into tables.
- [Make your own mod](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/guide/make-your-own/): There are two ways to make a mod. You can ask Claude in plain language, or you can write the code yourself.
- [mods가 뭔가요?](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/guide/what-are-mods/) (Korean): mod는 Claude Code 2.1.287부터 쓸 수 있는 공식 기능이에요. 플러그인(plugin) 안의 자바스크립트·타입스크립트 코드가 도구 호출이나 프롬프트 제출 같은 이벤트를 직접 받아서, Claude Code의 동작을 바꾸거나 화면을 그려요.
- [설치 가이드](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/guide/install/) (Korean): k-mods는 일반 Claude Code 플러그인 마켓플레이스예요. 그래서 설치·업데이트·제거가 전부 Claude Code의 /plugin 명령과 claude plugin 셸 명령으로 돼요.
- [mod를 안전하게 쓰는 법](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/guide/safety/) (Korean): mod는 샌드박스 없이 내 권한으로 Claude Code 안에서 돌아요. 그래서 설치하기 전에 뭘 할 수 있는지 알아 두는 게 중요해요.
- [mods 치트시트 (한국어)](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/guide/cheatsheet/) (Korean): mods 개발에 필요한 파일 구성, 이벤트, API, 렌더 사이트, 한계를 표로 압축했어요. 설명은 최대한 짧게 줄였으니 전체 맥락은 mods가 뭔가요?와 나만의 mod 만들기를 먼저 보세요.
- [나만의 mod 만들기](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/guide/make-your-own/) (Korean): mod를 만드는 방법은 두 가지예요. Claude에게 말로 시키거나, 직접 코드를 써도 돼요. 이 글은 두 방법을 모두 다루고, 마지막엔 완성한 mod를 k-mods에 올리는 절차로 이어져요.

## Korean UI (한국어화)

- [ko-ui](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/ko-ui/) (ko-ui): Dictionary-based mod that shows Claude Code's slash-command descriptions, /config rows, and some UI text in Korean. Install: `/plugin install ko-ui@k-mods`. Access: Reads conversation, Reads files.

## Themes (테마)

- [skins](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/skins/) (skins): Themed cards for tool rows, tables, code, shell output and Mermaid, with headings, alerts and task lists in the skin; fifteen skins you swap live with /skin Install: `/plugin install skins@k-mods`. Access: Network, Runs programs, Can hold/answer tool calls, Reads conversation, Reads env/settings, Reads files.
- [gfm-render](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/gfm-render/) (gfm-render): Renders GitHub Flavored Markdown alerts, task lists, strikethrough and Mermaid diagrams in the Claude Code transcript. Install: `/plugin install gfm-render@k-mods`. Access: Runs programs, Reads conversation.
- [prismantis](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/prismantis/) (prismantis): Colorful, themeable rendering for Claude Code replies across 15 themes: tables, code, diagrams, charts and tool rows, with copy buttons. Install: `/plugin install prismantis@k-mods`. Access: Reads conversation, Reads env/settings.

## Animation & fun (애니메이션)

- [pixel-pals](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/pixel-pals/) (pixel-pals): Pixel pals cross the band above the prompt while Claude works: Nyan Cat, Clawd, a shoot-em-up and more. Six curated scenes plus clawd-tales' Clawd story, in Korean Install: `/plugin install pixel-pals@k-mods`. Access: Can hold/answer tool calls, Reads conversation, Reads env/settings.
- [cc-arcade](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/cc-arcade/) (cc-arcade): Nine terminal mini-games above the prompt (snake, Tetris, 2048, and more), plus a pet that grows as Claude works. Install: `/plugin install cc-arcade@k-mods`. Access: Can hold/answer tool calls, Reads conversation.
- [clawd-spinner](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/clawd-spinner/) (clawd-spinner): Clawd acts out the spinner's word above it—cooking, dancing, pacing—with a scene for every one of 189 spinner words, no model calls. Install: `/plugin install clawd-spinner@k-mods`. Access: Reads conversation.
- [clawd-tales](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/clawd-tales/) (clawd-tales): A pixel Clawd acts out every tool call above the prompt, with helper characters for each subagent—terminal-first, no model calls. Install: `/plugin install clawd-tales@k-mods`. Access: Can hold/answer tool calls, Reads conversation.
- [combo-meter](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/combo-meter/) (combo-meter): A fighting-game combo meter: every clean tool call is a hit, every error breaks the chain. D to SSS ranks, pixel-art visuals. Install: `/plugin install combo-meter@k-mods`. Access: Can hold/answer tool calls, Reads conversation, Plays sound.
- [diff-invaders](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/diff-invaders/) (diff-invaders): Space Invaders where every wave is made from the lines Claude's last Edit/Write actually added; zero tokens, played above the prompt. Install: `/plugin install diff-invaders@k-mods`. Access: Can hold/answer tool calls, Reads conversation.
- [reels](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/reels/) (reels): Plays YouTube Shorts in a terminal pane while Claude works and pauses when it's done. Nothing starts until you run /reels. Install: `/plugin install reels@k-mods`. Access: Network, Runs programs, Reads conversation, Reads env/settings, Reads files.
- [tool-defense](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/tool-defense/) (tool-defense): A tower defense where every enemy is one of Claude's real tool calls (Bash, Edit, web/MCP, Agent); zero tokens, played above the prompt. Install: `/plugin install tool-defense@k-mods`. Access: Can hold/answer tool calls, Reads conversation.

## Status lines (상태줄)

- [Context Strip — ctx-strip](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/ctx-strip/) (컨텍스트 막대): A stacked bar above the prompt showing what fills your context window, plus a live line for running subagents Install: `/plugin install ctx-strip@k-mods`. Access: Runs programs, Writes files, Can hold/answer tool calls, Reads conversation, Reads env/settings.
- [agent-radar](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/agent-radar/) (agent-radar): Shows one live line per running subagent above the prompt: time, tool count, current action. /radar lists every agent and its messages. Install: `/plugin install agent-radar@k-mods`. Access: Can hold/answer tool calls, Reads conversation.
- [browser-lanes](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/browser-lanes/) (browser-lanes): Shows whether this session has a Playwright browser and who holds it, and makes subagents in the same session take turns using it. Install: `/plugin install browser-lanes@k-mods`. Access: Runs programs, Can hold/answer tool calls, Reads conversation.
- [cache-panel](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/cache-panel/) (cache-panel): A passive 50-minute prompt-cache reminder with keep-warm, ping-once or compact choices, each shown with a live cost estimate. Install: `/plugin install cache-panel@k-mods`. Access: Runs programs, Calls a model, Reads env/settings.
- [context-bar](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/context-bar/) (context-bar): Your context window as a stacked bar above the prompt, colored per category as /context does, with token counts and the compaction point. Install: `/plugin install context-bar@k-mods`. Access: Reads conversation.
- [flightdeck](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/flightdeck/) (flightdeck): A live terminal dashboard: model vitals, cost/context, an on-call architect, permission checks and subagent cards from real session events. Install: `/plugin install flightdeck@k-mods`. Access: Can hold/answer tool calls, Reads conversation.
- [hud](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/hud/) (hud): claude-hud 0.10.0 as a mod: model, project, git, context, usage, tools, agents, todos, alerts, budget, history, task summary, themes. Install: `/plugin install hud@k-mods`. Access: Runs programs, Writes files, Calls a model, Can hold/answer tool calls, Reads conversation, Reads env/settings, Reads files, Plays sound.
- [mod-usage](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/mod-usage/) (mod-usage): Shows context, 5-hour, and 7-day usage as gradient bars above the prompt. Desktop/VS Code only; 12 languages supported, not Korean yet. Install: `/plugin install mod-usage@k-mods`. Access: Runs programs, Reads env/settings.
- [pr-pulse](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/pr-pulse/) (pr-pulse): Live GitHub PR status in Claude Code: merge readiness, CI checks, review comments and your review queue, in a collapsible band and panes. Install: `/plugin install pr-pulse@k-mods`. Access: Runs programs, Submits prompts.
- [prompt-cache-control](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/prompt-cache-control/) (prompt-cache-control): Shows how much of each request's prompt the cache served vs wrote, counts down to expiry, and suggests /compact or /clear before it lapses. Install: `/plugin install prompt-cache-control@k-mods`. Access: Reads env/settings, Reads files.
- [receipt](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/receipt/) (receipt): What each turn did, in a band above the prompt: files/lines changed, commands and failures, reads, subagents; a toast when the model loops. Install: `/plugin install receipt@k-mods`. Access: Can hold/answer tool calls, Reads conversation, Reads env/settings.
- [review-watch](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/review-watch/) (review-watch): Shows one live line per running code review (a codex review command, or a review subagent): model, target, elapsed time, latest output. Install: `/plugin install review-watch@k-mods`. Access: Runs programs, Can hold/answer tool calls, Reads conversation, Reads env/settings.
- [statuspane](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/statuspane/) (statuspane): A status card above the prompt: model, effort, context, 5h/week limits, cost, directory and branch, with optional GitHub CI rows. Install: `/plugin install statuspane@k-mods`. Access: Runs programs, Can hold/answer tool calls, Reads conversation, Reads env/settings, Reads files.
- [taxi-meter](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/taxi-meter/) (taxi-meter): A taxi-meter panel above the prompt: session cost, model/tier, 5-hour and weekly limits with reset time, via /meter and /receipt. Install: `/plugin install taxi-meter@k-mods`. Access: Reads conversation, Plays sound.
- [todo-bar](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/todo-bar/) (todo-bar): Shows the task list's progress in a band above the prompt, read from the todo and task tools' own calls: no tool, no prompt, no tokens. Install: `/plugin install todo-bar@k-mods`. Access: Can hold/answer tool calls, Reads conversation, Reads env/settings.
- [token-weather](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/token-weather/) (token-weather): A live weather-style forecast of the context window above the prompt, with an icon, percent, and a bar chart of recent turns. Install: `/plugin install token-weather@k-mods`. Access: Reads conversation.
- [ts-band](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/ts-band/) (ts-band): Shows Tailscale nodes' state in a band above the prompt, with a toast when a node comes up or goes down. Install: `/plugin install ts-band@k-mods`. Access: Runs programs, Can hold/answer tool calls, Reads conversation, Reads env/settings.
- [usage-band-pawandeep](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/usage-band-pawandeep/) (usage-band-pawandeep): Always-visible 5-hour and weekly Claude usage percentages with a reset countdown above the prompt, plus new-chat and GitHub push buttons. Install: `/plugin install usage-band-pawandeep@k-mods`. Access: Runs programs, Submits prompts.

## Tools (도구)

- [Mod Store — mod-store](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/mod-store/) (모드 상점): Type /k-mods to browse this catalog in a pane and install or remove mods with one key Install: `/plugin install mod-store@k-mods`. Access: Runs programs, Reads env/settings.
- [Memo Pad — memo-pad](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/memo-pad/) (메모장): Jot down your next instructions while Claude works, then drop one into the prompt with a button Install: `/plugin install memo-pad@k-mods`. Access: Submits prompts.
- [Sticky Memo — sticky-memo](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/sticky-memo/) (붙임 메모): Pin frequently used snippets as colored chips above the prompt: click once to copy, twice to drop one into the prompt Install: `/plugin install sticky-memo@k-mods`. Access: Submits prompts, Reads conversation.
- [agent-flow](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/agent-flow/) (agent-flow): A side pane showing the main loop and every subagent as a live tree, with the context handed down and the answer handed back for each. Install: `/plugin install agent-flow@k-mods`. Access: Can hold/answer tool calls, Reads conversation.
- [agent-quick-menu](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/agent-quick-menu/) (agent-quick-menu): A pane and prompt band listing every installed plugin's commands and settings, with favourites and Claude Code's own /config rows. Install: `/plugin install agent-quick-menu@k-mods`. Access: Reads env/settings, Reads files.
- [image-view](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/image-view/) (image-view): See the images you paste into Claude Code: thumbnails above the prompt instead of bare [Image #1] tags. Install: `/plugin install image-view@k-mods`. Access: Runs programs, Reads conversation, Reads env/settings, Reads files.
- [modstage](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/modstage/) (modstage): Runs Codex, Grok, Muse, Antigravity, Kimi, Qwen Code and OpenCode as Claude Code subagents in live tabs, with approvals and steering. Install: `/plugin install modstage@k-mods`. Access: Network, Runs programs, Can hold/answer tool calls, Reads conversation, Reads env/settings, Reads files, Messages sessions.
- [now-playing](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/now-playing/) (now-playing): Shows Spotify's current track, progress, and synced lyrics above the prompt on macOS, with transport buttons and /music commands. Install: `/plugin install now-playing@k-mods`. Access: Network, Runs programs.
- [paste-view](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/paste-view/) (paste-view): See what you paste into Claude Code: image thumbnails and long-text previews above the prompt instead of bare placeholder tags. Install: `/plugin install paste-view@k-mods`. Access: Runs programs, Reads env/settings, Reads files.
- [pixel-player](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/pixel-player/) (pixel-player): A pixel-art music player pane that streams your playlist through mpv, with a character that reacts to the music. Install: `/plugin install pixel-player@k-mods`. Access: Runs programs, Writes files, Reads env/settings, Reads files.
- [prompt-rail](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/prompt-rail/) (prompt-rail): A rail of your session's prompts beside the transcript or above the prompt; hover to read one, click to jump to it. Install: `/plugin install prompt-rail@k-mods`. Access: Runs programs, Reads conversation, Reads files.
- [replay-theater](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/replay-theater/) (replay-theater): Step through the file edits Claude made in the last turn, one diff at a time, in a pane. Install: `/plugin install replay-theater@k-mods`. Access: Can hold/answer tool calls, Reads conversation, Reads files.
- [session-wrapped](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/session-wrapped/) (session-wrapped): Spotify-Wrapped-style recap for a Claude Code session: run /wrapped for an animated stat reveal, saved as a shareable PNG on your Desktop. Install: `/plugin install session-wrapped@k-mods`. Access: Runs programs, Can hold/answer tool calls, Reads conversation, Reads env/settings.
- [subagent-tuner](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/subagent-tuner/) (subagent-tuner): Chooses the model and reasoning effort of every subagent: ask before it starts, recommend by task kind, or apply a saved default over what the agent requested. Install: `/plugin install subagent-tuner@k-mods`. Access: Runs programs, Writes files, Can hold/answer tool calls.
- [taxi-blackbox](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/taxi-blackbox/) (taxi-blackbox): Records tool calls like a car's black box; replay the moments before an error or denial with /blackbox. Tokens and passwords are masked. Install: `/plugin install taxi-blackbox@k-mods`. Access: Can hold/answer tool calls, Reads conversation.
- [taxi-navi](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/taxi-navi/) (taxi-navi): Shows your todo list like a car navigation: progress path, next-step guidance, 'recalculating' on plan changes, an arrival announcement. Install: `/plugin install taxi-navi@k-mods`. Access: Can hold/answer tool calls, Reads env/settings, Plays sound.

## Automation (자동화)

- [Done Alarm — done-alarm](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/done-alarm/) (작업 끝 알림): Notifies you on your Mac, out loud, or on your phone (ntfy, Telegram, Slack, Discord) when a long turn ends or Claude needs you Install: `/plugin install done-alarm@k-mods`. Access: Network, Runs programs, Can hold/answer tool calls, Reads conversation, Plays sound.
- [agent-compact-advisor](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/agent-compact-advisor/) (agent-compact-advisor): Scores 0-100 how ready your session is to /compact, and adds a template to every compaction that preserves goals, decisions and leftovers. Install: `/plugin install agent-compact-advisor@k-mods`. Access: Network, Runs programs, Can hold/answer tool calls, Reads conversation.
- [auto-handoff](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/auto-handoff/) (auto-handoff): Hands a long session off to a fresh one with a Haiku-written brief instead of auto-compacting, with an optional viewer page for the brief. Install: `/plugin install auto-handoff@k-mods`. Access: Runs programs, Writes files, Calls a model, Can hold/answer tool calls, Submits prompts, Reads conversation, Reads env/settings, Reads files.
- [ctx-handoff](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/ctx-handoff/) (ctx-handoff): Auto handoff to a fresh conversation when context hits a threshold, with idle cache refresh and background project notes while you're away. Install: `/plugin install ctx-handoff@k-mods`. Access: Writes files, Calls a model, Submits prompts, Reads conversation, Reads env/settings, Reads files.
- [jev-skill-suggestion](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/jev-skill-suggestion/) (jev-skill-suggestion): Picks one skill per prompt and loads it while hiding the listing from context; uses TypeSafe's Jev with a key, else Claude's classifier. Install: `/plugin install jev-skill-suggestion@k-mods`. Access: Network, Calls a model, Reads conversation, Reads env/settings, Reads files.
- [next-steps](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/next-steps/) (next-steps): After each turn, suggests 2 or 3 likely next prompts above the input box; pressing 1, 2, or 3 drafts one into the empty prompt, 0 dismisses. Install: `/plugin install next-steps@k-mods`. Access: Calls a model, Reads conversation.
- [switchboard](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/switchboard/) (switchboard): Picks Haiku, Sonnet, or Opus for each subagent before it starts (an external routing API, or local rules), showing each pick and its cost. Install: `/plugin install switchboard@k-mods`. Access: Network, Reads conversation, Reads env/settings.
- [where-am-i](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/where-am-i/) (where-am-i): A live recap above the prompt (goal, doing now, waiting on you, next), with /where for a longer bullet-point summary. Install: `/plugin install where-am-i@k-mods`. Access: Calls a model, Can hold/answer tool calls, Reads conversation.

## Guards (지킴이)

- [Streamer Mode — streamer-mode](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/streamer-mode/) (스트리머 모드): Hides API keys, emails, phone numbers and Korean ID numbers on screen while you stream or share; Claude still sees the originals Install: `/plugin install streamer-mode@k-mods`. Access: Reads conversation.
- [blast-radius-ko](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/blast-radius-ko/) (blast-radius-ko): Holds irreversible commands (rm -rf, force push, DB resets, volume prunes) and shows what they would change before asking Install: `/plugin install blast-radius-ko@k-mods`. Access: Runs programs, Can hold/answer tool calls.
- [secret-redactor](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/secret-redactor/) (secret-redactor): Redacts API keys, JWTs, private keys and DB strings from tool results before the model reads them; blocks placeholder reuse in Bash. Install: `/plugin install secret-redactor@k-mods`. Access: Can hold/answer tool calls.
- [secret-vault](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/secret-vault/) (secret-vault): Hides pasted or tool-read secrets, emails and IPs with stable placeholders, restoring real values only right before a tool runs. Install: `/plugin install secret-vault@k-mods`. Access: Can hold/answer tool calls, Reads conversation.
- [taxi-speedcam](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/taxi-speedcam/) (taxi-speedcam): A speed camera for dangerous Bash commands: force push, rm -rf, DB drops, discarding changes, prod deploys. Asks first, or always blocks. Install: `/plugin install taxi-speedcam@k-mods`. Access: Can hold/answer tool calls, Plays sound.

## Integrations (연동)

- [cc-pr-tracker](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/cc-pr-tracker/) (cc-pr-tracker): Watches GitHub PRs from your session—merge state, review, and required checks above the prompt—with alerts when they change. Install: `/plugin install cc-pr-tracker@k-mods`. Access: Runs programs, Can hold/answer tool calls, Reads conversation, Reads env/settings, Reads files.
- [github-issues](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/github-issues/) (github-issues): A side pane of a repository's GitHub issues as cards, with search, label filters and a button to hand one to Claude. Install: `/plugin install github-issues@k-mods`. Access: Runs programs, Submits prompts, Reads conversation.
- [glance](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/glance/) (glance): One line above the prompt for what needs you: the next meeting, PRs awaiting review, in-progress Linear issues, and recent Slack DMs. Install: `/plugin install glance@k-mods`. Access: Network, Runs programs.
- [linear-board](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/linear-board/) (linear-board): Your Linear projects, milestones and issues in a pane; plan, execute or product buttons send a ready prompt into the session. Install: `/plugin install linear-board@k-mods`. Access: Network, Runs programs, Submits prompts, Reads conversation, Reads env/settings.
- [linear-tickets](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/linear-tickets/) (linear-tickets): Shows your assigned Linear tickets in a pane; click one to load it into the session, read details, comment, or change status and priority. Install: `/plugin install linear-tickets@k-mods`. Access: Network, Runs programs, Submits prompts.
- [terminal-browser](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/terminal-browser/) (terminal-browser): Renders a real browser inside Claude Code's terminal so you/the agent can preview web pages; needs the separate terminal-browser app. Install: `/plugin install terminal-browser@k-mods`. Access: Network, Runs programs, Can hold/answer tool calls, Submits prompts, Reads files.
- [vercel-deploy-status](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/vercel-deploy-status/) (vercel-deploy-status): Pins the linked Vercel project's deploy queue above the prompt, one line per deploy with phase and elapsed time. Install: `/plugin install vercel-deploy-status@k-mods`. Access: Runs programs, Can hold/answer tool calls, Reads files.

## Bundles (묶음)

- [Korean Pack — korean-pack](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/korean-pack/) (한국어 팩): One install for a Korean Claude Code: menu, settings and status-line translation (ko-ui) Install: `/plugin install korean-pack@k-mods`. Access: bundle.
- [Starter Set — starter](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/starter/) (추천 세트): The k-mods starter set: ko-ui, skins, pixel-pals, ctx-strip and mod-store in one install Install: `/plugin install starter@k-mods`. Access: bundle.
- [Taxi Pack — taxi-pack](https://dogebi.github.io/k-mods/en/mods/taxi-pack/) (택시팩): Claude Code as a taxi ride: meter (cost and limits), navigation (todo route), speed camera (risky-command check) and dashcam (tool-call recorder) in one install Install: `/plugin install taxi-pack@k-mods`. Access: bundle.
